title: feat(2d): Slot Undercut for T-slot, keyseat, dovetail and lollipop cutters
body:
## What changed

This PR adds the Slot Undercut operation and the cutters for it.

- **Four cutter kinds** in `camcraft-tools`: `t_slot`, `keyseat`, `dovetail`, `lollipop`. They use the existing tool fields. `diameter` is the head. `flute_len` is the head height. `shank_d` and `shank_len` are the neck. `tip_angle` is the dovetail flank angle. The kind words are additive, so `PROJECT_VERSION` does not change. The starter catalog has one cutter of each kind.
- **One generator** in `camcraft-motion` (`machining2d::undercut`). It cuts a straight slot or a circular slot (DXF-style bulge). It changes Z at one XY station only, outside the wall. It feeds in sideways, cuts the centre pass and the radial stepover passes at one depth, feeds out the same way, then lifts. The pass offset comes from the widest point of the cutter profile, not from the tip.
- **One verify law** in `camcraft-sim` (`Mode::Undercut`, `verify/undercut.rs`). A move that changes Z while material is in or over the head is `Warning::UndercutLift`. It blocks the post. A neck or holder band with material above its bottom is a `ShankHit`. The operation layer reads the two again against the stock that the earlier operations left (`acquit_undercut_by_prior`). A neck slot that an earlier Slot operation cut is then air.
- **The true profile in the solid law.** The solid law judges a dovetail as a frustum and a lollipop as a full ball (`Prof::Dove`, `Prof::Ball`). The head top gets the same allowance as the tip, so a head that stands under its roof is contact and not a gouge.
- **The true profile in the field stock simulation** (`Stock::simulate_undercut`). The head and the neck are two convex solids. The field keeps their union. A new exact frustum solid is `SdfTool::Dovetail`. The stock view uses this.
- **The column engines cut nothing for an undercut.** A column has one top for each (x, y). It cannot hold air below material.
- **App**: `OpParams::SlotUndercut` (kind tag 44, appended), the project file mirror, the stamp digest, heights, the part solid law for a part source, the kept-parts law for a stock source.
- **MCP**: `add_operation` with kind `Slot Undercut` (key `slot_undercut`) and `add_tool` with the new kind words. `verify` reports the new finding kind `undercut_lift`. No new MCP tool is necessary: the generic tools call the same undoable commands.
- **UI**: the tool kinds in the tool page, the operation page (`undercut_page.rs`), five original icons (SVG masters, rendered with `cargo xtask icons`).
- **Docs**: a Slot Undercut section in the 2D operations guide, and `docs/decisions/1444-slot-undercut.md`.

## Cause

There was no cutter kind with a head wider than its neck, and no operation for one. The laws for a plain contour are wrong below a roof. The column model reads a pass as a cleared kerf, so a lift through the roof passes as a retract in its own kerf.

## Tests

New pins. Each one did not exist before this PR (the code under test is new), so "red before the fix" is shown by the mutation results below.

- `camcraft-tools` `undercut::tests` (7 tests): sane cutters, refusals by name, the profile contact point, the drawn outline.
- `camcraft-motion` `machining2d::undercut::tests` (8 tests): `every_z_move_stands_at_the_entry_station`, `an_entry_slot_too_narrow_for_the_neck_is_refused_by_name`, `a_curved_slot_rides_concentric_arcs`, `the_passes_widen_to_the_wall_by_the_profile_contact_radius`, `bad_input_is_refused_by_name`, and three more.
- `camcraft-sim` `tests/undercut_laws.rs` (14 tests): `a_retract_inside_the_undercut_is_refused`, `a_dive_into_uncut_stock_is_refused`, `the_neck_through_uncut_stock_is_a_collision`, `a_slot_mouth_narrower_than_the_neck_is_a_collision`, `the_solid_law_reads_a_dovetail_as_a_frustum`, `the_solid_law_reads_a_lollipop_as_a_whole_ball`, `a_head_standing_under_its_roof_is_contact_and_one_lifted_into_it_is_a_gouge`, `the_field_removes_the_undercut_and_keeps_the_roof`, `the_field_cuts_a_dovetail_wall_on_its_slope`, `the_field_cuts_a_lollipop_groove_round`, and three more.
- `camcraft-app` `tests/mcp_slot_undercut.rs` (5 tests): a T-slot block is cut, verified and posted through the MCP tools; an end mill and a narrow entry slot are refused by name; a missing neck slot holds the post; a Z move with the head below the stock holds the post; a cut below the part floor is a gouge that holds the post.
- `camcraft-app` `tests/golden_undercut.rs` (4 tests) with four new golden CL files.
- `camcraft-app` `tests/tool_law.rs`: `undercut_cutters_mount_only_the_slot_undercut`.

Tests changed because the change extends a pinned list:

- `tool_sanity_tests.rs` and `tests/tool_law.rs`: the tool kind lists (18 to 22).
- `catalog_asset_tests.rs`: the catalog order (33 to 37 entries).
- `operation/tests.rs` (kind count 44 to 45), `lathe_voice_tests.rs` (refused count 31 to 32), `tests/ribbon.rs` (the last kind), `tests/coarse_laws.rs` (the kind is refused on a reduced model), `tests/tool_gate.rs` (the catalog hint for the new kind).
- Seven test files got the new `undercut: None` field in a full `Cutter` literal.

Mutation results (each guard removed, the pin run, the guard put back):

- M1 undercut lift law off: RED (`a_retract_inside_the_undercut_is_refused`, `a_dive_into_uncut_stock_is_refused`). Restored: GREEN.
- M2 neck and holder band law off: RED (`the_neck_through_uncut_stock_is_a_collision`, `a_slot_mouth_narrower_than_the_neck_is_a_collision`, `an_unknown_prior_height_keeps_the_conviction`). Restored: GREEN.
- M3 solid law reads the radius at the top of a span, as before: first run GREEN (not pinned). I added `a_wall_is_judged_at_the_heads_widest_height_not_at_its_top`. Second run: RED. Restored: GREEN.
- M4 head top allowance off: RED (`a_head_standing_under_its_roof_is_contact_and_one_lifted_into_it_is_a_gouge`). Restored: GREEN.
- M5 field neck cut with the head radius: RED (`the_field_removes_the_undercut_and_keeps_the_roof`, `the_field_cuts_a_lollipop_groove_round`). Restored: GREEN.
- M6 neck slot refusal off: RED (`an_entry_slot_too_narrow_for_the_neck_is_refused_by_name`). Restored: GREEN.
- M7 generator lifts where it stands, not at the station: RED (`every_z_move_stands_at_the_entry_station` and four more; the generator's own check refuses the path). Restored: GREEN.
- M8 part solid law off for the undercut: RED (`an_undercut_below_the_parts_floor_is_a_gouge_that_holds_the_post`). Restored: GREEN.
- M9 column engines cut the undercut as a flat mill: RED (`a_t_slot_is_cut_verified_and_posted_over_the_tools`). Restored: GREEN.
- M10 re-read against the earlier stock off: RED (`a_t_slot_is_cut_verified_and_posted_over_the_tools`). Restored: GREEN.
- Not pinned: `Rest::new` takes no cut from an undercut path. The undercut law does not read the rest model, so no test goes red without it. It keeps the rapid law from reading a pass as a cleared kerf.

Gate: the branch contains `upstream/main` 409c0b5ab (merged in, no conflict). `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` on that head: 725 steps, 724 green, 1 red. The red test is `feature_edge_g1_join::no_pickable_edge_is_a_tangent_piece_of_a_longer_one_in_any_step_fixture`. It fails on `bar_cross_holes.step`, a fixture that is new on `main`. This PR does not change STEP import or feature edges. Issue #2713 reports it. Before the merge of `main`, the same gate was green on this change (716 steps, 0 failed), after one run with three red list pins that this change extends (kind count, refused count, catalog hint). `cargo clippy -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean on the final head.

## Goldens moved

No existing golden changed. Four golden CL files are new:

- `slot_undercut_tslot_straight.cl`
- `slot_undercut_keyseat_arc.cl`
- `slot_undercut_dovetail_straight.cl`
- `slot_undercut_lollipop_arc.cl`

No snapshot PNG changed. Five icon PNGs are new (`cargo xtask icons` wrote them from the new SVG masters and changed no other PNG).

## Not exercised

- **No literature search was run.** The issue asks for a Perplexity search first. This session had no web tool and no Perplexity tool. The code was written from published material that the decision file names (Machinery's Handbook for the cutter forms; Requicha and Voelcker 1982 and Frisken et al. 2000 for the union of convex solids on a distance field; the sources of the existing solid law). The maintainer can ask for the search against that list. camlib was not read.
- The UI page and the icons compile and the UI suites pass. No person looked at the page in the running app. No UI test opens the new page.
- Dovetail and lollipop parts are not tested through the app. Their profiles are tested in the sim crate (solid law and field stock) and the generator.
- The stock view with an undercut operation is not tested through the app. `Stock::simulate_undercut` is tested in the sim crate.
- The program verdict before a post reads the stock from above. It does not show the undercut as removed. The undercut law and the solid law judge the operation instead.
- A flipped WCS and a rotated work offset refuse the kind. An aligned setup and a WCS yaw do not list it. No 3+2 tilt.
- One depth level for each operation. The far end of a blind slot stays square. The centre line is typed, not picked.
- Issue #896 (form cutters with a drawn outline, corner rounding, slitting saw) stays open. This PR adds only the four parametric kinds that #1444 needs.

## Overlaps

No open PR changes the same function. These open PRs change other functions in the same files. The PR that merges second refreshes.

- #2678, #2149: `mcp/job.rs`, `operation/generate.rs`, `project/file.rs`, `verify/mod.rs`, `verify/probe.rs`, `verify/types.rs`, `ui/state.rs`
- #2675, #2666: `operation/generate.rs`
- #2663: `ui/egui_app/tool_settings.rs`
- #2665, #2662, #1798: `ui/state.rs` (#1798 also `icons.rs`)
- #2594: `ui/egui_app/browser_tree.rs`

#2670, #2563 and #1713 changed the same files and merged while this work ran. Their changes are in the branch through the merge of `main`.

Effort: max. The issue did not escalate.

Changelog: Slot Undercut operation for T-slot, keyseat, dovetail and lollipop cutters: the cutter enters and leaves sideways at depth, a Z move with material over the head is refused, the neck is checked against the slot mouth, and the stock view shows the true undercut.

Fixes #1444
